first_trial: Unchanged CLOSED_WITHOUT_PROMOTION for its declared two-case full-over-local condition.
exposure_limit: Counts include two nonself confirmed targets and two rejected targets in the reference episode; they are exposed diagnostics. Outside the reference episode there are only four confirmed targets and one rejected target, from the same source.
source_bindings: Actual inference remains regional-context preference; no dense role truth, selector, new labels or public-source transfer.
findings: Local preserves all six nonself reviewed target contexts, including 49.5s and 52s missed by full and the old mean diagnostic.
Full opposes all three reviewed wrong targets, but misses those two protected target contexts; 44s texture preference has margin only 0.0027177911518383446.
Local still gives interface preference to the known wrong 44s target.
Full and local retain multiple distinct unreviewed interface coordinates in most frames; full has only unreviewed alternatives at 49.5s and 52s. Those are not successful replacements.
No frozen single mode demonstrates the joint wrong-target opposition and protected-target preservation needed for a physical selection claim.
next_boundary: A separate operating-policy design must explain how to use these competing signals while preserving unassessed alternatives and normal observations; no threshold/OR/AND combination is adopted from these results. No new model/reference/scale/label search is authorized by this review.
not_evaluated: Windows resources, O2/O3 and field acceptance
environment_retention: User explicitly retains environment, weights and caches until a future cleanup request.
review_image: primary-pair-and-references.png; visual check complete, all eight panels and original-anchor labels legible; no new physical labeling

categorical_pair_collision.consequence: A deterministic consumer using only the two categorical preferences cannot oppose the known wrong 44s candidate while preserving both known 49.5s/52s targets. Continuous-score policies remain unassessed; this is not a general impossibility result.
